about_the_game:
This is Tao Yuanming's poem "A Comprehensive View of the Biography of King Zhou and a Flow of Mountains and Seas", as well as Lu Xun's "Ah Chang and the Classic of Mountains and Seas". As the core source of Chinese mythology, the cultural influence of the Classic of Mountains and Seas is beyond doubt, and "The Great Wastes" is rooted in it.

In 'The Great Wastes', you can travel around the ancient world of mountains and seas, but why did the mountains fall? Why did Jianmu break? Why does black mist pervade the whole world? Can the dying Fusang Tree be revived? What are the unknown secrets behind ancient myths?

Converse with ancient gods, fight against ancient demons, traverse mountains and seas, and your footprints will be a map of mountains and seas that belongs to you.

The magnificent and unique world of mountains and seas

Here, there are mountains that are not surrounded and collapsing; There are wooden structures that are broken; Xiangliu Gonggong was imprisoned; Chiyou Xingtian was dismembered and sealed.

Here, there is the missing Queen Mother of the West, the shattered Yinglong with divine power, the vanished Three Emperors and Five Emperors, and the missing King Yu.

Here, there are the battles of Hanquan, Zhuolu, Xingtian beheading, Yi shooting for nine days, N ü wa repairing the sky, and Kuafu chasing the sun.

Why does black mist pervade the whole world? Where have all the ancient gods gone? The secrets behind myths are waiting for you to explore.

Classic 2D Pixel Style

The game adopts a classic 2D pixel style, evoking childhood memories and full of retro sentiment. In the game, you can see pixelated mountain and sea mythical beasts with a unique style.

Turn based Chess Strategy Battle

The game adopts traditional classic turn based combat, where you can freely arrange troops and formations, match skills and equipment, fully reflecting the charm of chess strategy.

Hard core mechanism based skill design

We have designed skills that fit each character's personality, and BOSS skills are also in line with their mythological story background.

In addition, we have set up a rich battlefield mechanism where you can combine skills, characteristics, and equipment to create your own unique combat strategy.

Restoring the Mountain and Sea Map

We have restored the map of the world of mountains and seas. As the plot develops, what is ultimately presented to players is a vast and magnificent map of mountains and seas, including the "Wuzang Mountain Sutra", "Overseas and Domestic Sutra", and "Great Wilderness Sutra".

We have arranged corresponding monsters, mythical beasts, and vegetation minerals in different mountain ranges based on the original text of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, just to provide everyone with a more realistic experience of the world of mountains and seas.

short_description: "The Great Wastes" is a pixelated fantasy RPG. You will play the role of a young man, explore the ancient world of mountains and seas. Casting artifacts, refining elixirs of immortality, new myths to be written by you, and mysterious maps of the Great Wilderness waiting for you to open!
